关于VAE

Liquidn2vae_IG4是一个针对 Ideogram 4 风格工作流程的实验性饱和度调整 VAE。

它可能会产生：

  • 饱和度更强

  • 较暖的色彩反应

  • 更清晰的彩色背景

  • 更丰富的动漫风格色彩

已知的限制

  • 线条艺术阴影可能会变成粉红色或洋红色

  • 真实感图像的饱和度可能不稳定

  • 中性灰色区域可能会变得比预期更温暖

这是一个非官方的实验工作流程，而不是官方的 Ideogram、FLUX.2、Black Forest Labs 或 Comfy-Org 版本。

About the VAE

liquidn2vae_IG4is an experimental saturation-tuned VAE for Ideogram 4-style workflows.

It may produce:

  • stronger saturation

  • warmer color response

  • clearer colorful backgrounds

  • richer anime-style colors

Known limitations

  • line-art shadows may become pink or magenta

  • photorealistic images may have unstable saturation

  • neutral gray areas may become warmer than intended

This is an unofficial experimental workflow and not an official Ideogram, FLUX.2, Black Forest Labs, or Comfy-Org release.
